prompt: Electricity is sent across a country at very high voltage and much lower current, rather than at household voltage. For the same delivered power, this mainly reduces:

options.text: The speed at which electricity travels through the wires
The need for power stations to generate electricity at night
Energy wasted as heat in the wires, because heating losses rise with the square of the current
The frequency of the alternating current

explanation: Power is voltage × current, so raising voltage lowers the current needed for the same power. Resistive heating loss is I²R, so a lower current cuts wasted heat in transmission lines dramatically.
